bounty.note: A bounty with a big reward: 500 coins and a weapon, recorded as the quest's terms.

rounds.text: The organiser pins a fresh notice: wolves on the north road, five hundred coins and the old captain's sword to whoever clears them.

arguments.title: Wolf bounty on the north road
arguments.description: Clear the wolves off the north road and bring back the pelts as proof.

items.name: Captain's trophy sword
items.properties: 1d8 slashing; an old officer's blade, well kept.

rounds.text: "Pelts as proof," he adds. "The council doesn't pay for stories."

claim.note: Three days later: time passes, the quest completes, the reward is paid once in full — coins and the sword.

rounds.text: Three days on the north road. You come back with the pelts over your shoulder.

arguments.reason: three days hunting wolves on the north road

rounds.text: The organiser counts out five hundred coins and lays the captain's sword across the counter. "Council's thanks. Don't spend it all in one tavern."
